Reveal.js 6.0.2
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/reveal.js/-/reveal.js-6.0.2.tgz
The official npm tarball was verified against its published SHA-512 integrity.
Only dist/reveal.js, dist/reveal.css and LICENSE are vendored.

Speaker notes use this site's accessible dialog rather than an external notes iframe.
